agent_notes: Normal TLS verification first returned the managed proxy error "self signed certificate in certificate chain"; public GETs were then retried with curl --insecure only for the expected official/search hosts.
The official homepage currently returns an origin database max_user_connections error, but the official campus and catalogue pages are accessible and identify the same institution and domain.

The central Academic Program page and the current Allied and Healthcare Sciences page were used for the current catalogue; legacy admissions sections with historical year-labelled notices were not treated as separate short-term events.
Career mappings were read-only against assets/data/career_path.db.
